videos.script: Every credential in this course still works. The Git tokens, the signing key, the age key, Vault's root token. Each one, if it leaks, keeps working until somebody stops it. {{lifetimes}} This lesson shortens those lives. Vault makes a database password on request, with an hour to live, and drops it when the hour is up. Nobody rotates it, because nobody keeps it. {{dynamic}} The tokens that have to stay are rotated in four steps, in an order that never breaks anything. {{rotation}} Then the other half: what each identity may do. Flux applies everything as cluster administrator. You give staging an account of its own, and watch Flux refuse a pull request that reaches past it. {{privilege}}
